Drop your weapons and we'll go easy on you.|Daro Blunt, to a group of adventurers|<ref name="Trouble Brewing">{{FFG|story=Trouble Brewing|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook}}</ref>}}
'''Daro Blunt''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in the band of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Bandin Dobah]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After being informed by [[Zalg]] that a group of adventurers tracked down Dobah to retrieve the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R4-W9]], he tried with [[Spir Fraxis]] and [[Gut-Guro]] to kill them.
